A 401 error when using the GET /products endpoint in the Admin API means the token is missing, unknown, or revoked. Please double-check that your token is correct, active, and properly included in your API request. Never share your real token publicly; what you shared should be replaced by a real one securely stored.

If you still get this error, the token might be revoked or invalid for your store. You can check your token's status in your Kaizena Flow admin under the API or developer settings section.

If you want, I can guide you through how to set up and use your Admin API token properly.
